definition: Official ASR-RC-TBL-002 documentation explicitly counts each deceased victim; includes first/second-degree murder and manslaughter; excludes criminal negligence, suicide, accidental and justifiable homicide. OCC_YEAR is year offence occurred.

scope: Reported murder and manslaughter deceased victims form a conditional offence superset for intentional homicide; no claim of observed intentional-only point rate. Population is city July2025. Unreported/resident vital mortality not bounded.
